title: Five Themes Running Through the Field
dek: We did Dorst’s fifth step on the 50 organizations around The Labs: what they’re really after, where it meets what alumni and organizers told us, and four frames to test before the Nov 14 vote.
cover_alt: Five coloured lines run down the page, one per theme: Being Recognized, Knowing Where You Are, Someone Beside You, Lasting Past the End, Becoming Someone New. Each row is an organization, with a station on every line whose theme it carries.
